strategy.description: The same connected mountain geometry with one shared structural ink plan for wet, texture and bone passes. World-space normal/light weighting is rechecked along brush routes; a few visible branching and summit nodes receive focal dark ink. Selected 1–2px pigment edges soften, foreground contacts run across and diagonally, and pine tufts use overlapping hemispherical groups.
strategy.tradeoffs: The upper-right backlight and ink grouping are authored pictorial assumptions, not calibrated reconstruction or physical shadow transport. Interior geometry/depth and the fixed scene plan remain unchanged; local silhouette coverage is deliberately adjusted at a few edge pixels. This is a static artistic candidate, not a default effect or film.
